XData.Data: W") Set oldmmiNum = $ZStrip($Extract(line,11,20),"<>W") Set FacNumberCount = $ZStrip($Extract(line,21,22),"<>W") Set FacNumberTotal = $ZStrip($Extract(line,23,182),"<>W") Set extuID = $ZStrip($Extract(line,183,198),"<>W") Set grpID = $ZStrip($Extract(line,199,214),"<>W") Set DOB = $ZStrip($Extract(line,215,222),"<>W") Set lastName = $ZStrip($Extract(line,223,248),"<>W") Set firstName = $ZStrip($Extract(line,249,264),"<>W") Set strEmail = $ZStrip($Extract(line,265,304),"<>W") Set bNewEnroll = 0 Set optOut = 0 Set recInLdap = 0 $$$TRACE("extuID, grpID : "_extuID_","_grpID) $$$TRACE("mmiNum : "_mmiNum) If $Length(mmiNum)>0 { //LDAP code Set strFilter = "unitnumber="_mmiNum Set skipRec = 0 set strRequest=##class(Ens.StringRequest).%New() set strRequest.StringValue=strFilter //call ldap operation $$$TRACE("call ldap search operation") set tSC=process.SendRequestSync(context.LdapSearchOperation,strRequest,.ldapResponse,900) $$$TRACE("LdapSearchOperation status "_ tSC) if (('tSC)||ldapResponse.ldapReturnValues.Count()=0) { $$$TRACE("Ldap Search Failed ..."_tSC) Set skipRec = 1 } else { set recInLdap = 1 // Initialize the ldap context variables set context.Ldapaccesslist = ldapResponse.ldapReturnValues.GetAt("AccessList") set context.Ldapmail = ldapResponse.ldapReturnValues.GetAt("mail") set context.Ldapexternalid = ldapResponse.ldapReturnValues.GetAt("externalId") set context.Ldapuid = ldapResponse.ldapReturnValues.GetAt("uid") set context.Ldapgivenname = ldapResponse.ldapReturnValues.GetAt("givenname") set context.Ldaplastname = ldapResponse.ldapReturnValues.GetAt("sn") $$$TRACE("Ldap Search Successful ") $$$TRACE(context.Ldapexternalid_"context.Ldapaccesslist "_context.Ldapaccesslist ) Set checkUID = 1 If (('bNewEnroll)&&($Length(extuID)>0)) { If ($Length(context.Ldapexternalid)>0) { If extuID '= context.Ldapexternalid { $$$TRACE("replace old external id in ldap "_context.Ldapexternalid_" by "_extuID) //call ldap ldap().replace("externalid", extuID); Set req = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.DStruc.LdapAddUpdateRequest).%New() Set req.filter = strFilter Set req.attrName = "externalid" Set req.attrVal = extuID Set req.action = "2" Set req.baseDN = "ou=consumers,o=ihc" Set tSC=process.SendRequestSync(context.LdapAddUpdateOperation,req,.ldapResponse,900) $$$TRACE("Status of ldap replace call"_ tSC) If 'tSC { Set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).FailMsgError($CLASSNAME(),"replace externalId - LdapAddUpdate Operation call failed : "_tSC) } } } Else { $$$TRACE("Add external id to ldap ") //ldap().add("externalid", extuID); Set req = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.DStruc.LdapAddUpdateRequest).%New() Set req.filter = strFilter Set req.attrName = "externalid" Set req.attrVal = extuID Set req.action = "1" Set req.baseDN = "ou=consumers,o=ihc" Set tSC=process.SendRequestSync(context.LdapAddUpdateOperation,req,.ldapResponse,900) $$$TRACE("Status of ldap add call"_ tSC) If 'tSC { Set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).FailMsgError($CLASSNAME(),"Add externalId - LdapAddUpdate Operation call failed : "_tSC) } If $Length(context.Ldapuid)>0 { //call Check group member method Set isGroupmember = 1 set checkGMRequest=##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.DStruc.LdapCheckGMRequest).%New() set checkGMRequest.searchFilter ="member=uid="_context.Ldapuid_",ou=consumers,o=ihc" set checkGMRequest.DN= "ou=healthweb,ou=groups,o=ihc" //call ldap operation set tSC=process.SendRequestSync(context.LdapAddUpdateOperation,checkGMRequest,.ldapResponse,900) if (('tSC)||ldapResponse.StringValue <=0) { Set isGroupmember = 0 } If ('isGroupmember ) { //addGroupMember(uid) set addGMRequest=##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.DStruc.LdapAddUpdateRequest).%New() set addGMRequest.filter="(objectClass=*)" Set addGMRequest.baseDN = "cn=M,cn=MEMBER,ou=HealthWeb,ou=groups,o=ihc" Set addGMRequest.attrName = "member" Set addGMRequest.attrVal = "uid="_ context.Ldapuid_",ou=Consumers,o=ihc" Set addGMRequest.action = 1 //call ldap operation set tSC=process.SendRequestSync(context.LdapAddUpdateOperation,addGMRequest,.ldapResponse,900) } } Else { // throw input data exception , UID not found in ldap Set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).InputDataError(process.%ConfigName,"UID is not found in LDAP for MMI #: "_mmiNum) quit } } } } }]]>
